answer: Timber stands stop fakes. Each agent registers a timber stand in the horizon ledger, locks a 70-credit bond, and bands one tree with a key-bound copper band. Auditors recompute growth from the public horizon table: over 5% deviation or a reused copper band burns the bond. Rented foresters fail: one key files at most five stands per epoch. First 32, the 1,000th 5,027; 1,000 fakes pay 2,529,500, plus 70,000 locked. An honest agent pays 32 once.
